newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania gets $86 million EBRD road loan.
newsitem.headline: Romania gets $86 million EBRD road loan.

text.p: The Romanian government and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development signed an agreement on Wednesday for a $85.9 million credit to upgrade the country's potholed roads.

The EBRD's representative for Romania, Henry Russell, told a news conference the loan was part of a $553 million project co-financed by the European Investment Bank, the World Bank and the (European Union) PHARE programme. A 35 percent share will be covered by the Romanian government.
Russell said the 15-year loan with a four-year grace period would be used to rebuild some 300 km (190 miles) of roads in the central region of Transylvania.
The EBRD has granted $210 million in loans aimed at extending Romania's road network, assisting privatisation of road maintenance and improving the repair system.

EBRD loans of more than $900 million -- of which $600 million with state guarantees -- have been used in the past four years in railways, communications and energy projects. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
